cues.en: In the last lecture we discussed some theoretical concepts regarding traffic.
cues.zh: 上一堂課介紹了 Traefik 的一些理論概念。

cues.en: I hope you did not skip it.
To get started with traffic.
Let's create a traffic configuration file.
cues.zh: 先建立 Traefik 設定檔。

cues.en: Traffic proxy configuration is divided into two main categories.
cues.zh: Traefik Proxy 的設定分成兩大類。

cues.en: We have the static configuration, which defines parameters that require traffic to restart when changed.
cues.zh: 第一類是靜態設定，參數變更後需要重新啟動 Traefik。

cues.en: Then we have the dynamic configuration, which involves elements that can be updated without restarting traffic.
cues.zh: 第二類是動態設定，其中的項目可以更新，不必重新啟動 Traefik。

cues.en: As you can see from this documentation, we are told it's crucial to choose one method and stick to it, as mixing different configuration options is not supported and can lead to unexpected behavior.
cues.zh: 文件中提醒，必須選擇一種方式並持續使用，因為不支援混用不同設定選項，否則可能產生非預期行為。

cues.en: In our case, in development, we shall go with the option of creating static configuration using a file.
cues.zh: 我們在開發環境中，會使用檔案建立靜態設定。

cues.en: This file based static traffic configuration is going to use the dot yml extension, just like we did in our Docker compose file.
cues.zh: 以檔案為基礎的 Traefik 靜態設定，使用 .yml 副檔名，和 Docker Compose 一樣。

cues.en: So you can go back to our IDE.
Then we're going to go to backend, then Docker.
Then within the Docker directory we're going to go to local.
cues.zh: 在 docker 裡進入 local。

cues.en: Then within local we're going to create a new folder.
That folder is going to be called traffic.
Like that.
The spelling is a bit weird, but it's okay.
cues.zh: 拼字有點特別，不過沒關係。

cues.en: It's traffic like that.
Then within this folder we're going to create a new file and that's going to be traffic dot yml like that.
So it's backend, then Docker, then local, then traffic, then traffic dot yml.
Then we can start working on this file.
So as usual remember this is a YAML file.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，記得這是 YAML 檔，

cues.en: So we have to get the indentation correct.
Otherwise it's going to error out as you've seen me make that mistake before.
cues.zh: 否則就會報錯，先前我已經示範過這種錯誤。

cues.en: So you can see API.
This is going to enable the API dashboard for monitoring and management.
cues.zh: 這會啟用 API 儀表板，用於監控與管理。

cues.en: So you can see API.
Then enter tab.
Make sure the indentation is correct.
Then we can enable the dashboard by saying dashboard and setting it to true like that.
cues.zh: 接著設定 dashboard: true，啟用儀表板。

cues.en: Then since we're in development we're going to allow access to the dashboard without authentication.
cues.zh: 因為目前是開發環境，所以允許未經驗證就存取儀表板。

cues.en: So you can say insecure and set that to true.
Remember Insecure and Dashboard are on the same line.
cues.zh: 記得，insecure 與 dashboard 在同一層。

cues.en: Then we're going to configure logging.
So you can go back to the same level as API.
cues.zh: 退回和 api 同一層，

cues.en: And you can say log.
Then tab the log level.
That's going to be debug.
These logs that you're sitting up here are used to log traffic's internal operations events and errors.
cues.zh: 這裡設定的日誌，用來記錄 Traefik 內部操作、事件與錯誤。

cues.en: So after the level we can say format.
The format is going to be JSON.
Then we're going to configure access logging.
And this is going to be used to log any HTTP and HTTP requests and responses that pass through traffic.
cues.zh: 用來記錄通過 Traefik 的 HTTP 與 HTTPS 請求及回應。

cues.en: So you can see the access log like that.
Then enter tab the format that's going to be JSON.
cues.zh: 按 Enter，縮排，format 設為 JSON。

cues.en: Then you're going to specify the path to the access log file by saying file path.
cues.zh: 再用 filePath 指定存取日誌檔路徑。

cues.en: And that's going to be slash then slash log then slash traffic then slash access dot log.
cues.zh: 路徑是 log/traefik 底下的 access.log。

cues.en: Then we're going to configure the retry middleware.
cues.zh: 接著設定 retry 中介軟體。

cues.en: And this is going to use to retry requests that fail.
As you can see middlewares.
And we can say retry then tab then retry like that.
cues.zh: 再輸入 retry，縮排後再輸入 retry。

cues.en: I'm going to explain this.
So this first retry is the name of the middleware.
cues.zh: 第一個 retry 是中介軟體的名稱。

cues.en: We could as well name it anything we like.
So you could as well say retry then hyphen one like that.
But you can just leave it as retry.
Then this second retry now specifies the middleware type.
cues.zh: 第二個 retry 指定中介軟體的類型。

cues.en: In this case it's the retry middleware.
cues.zh: 這裡就是重試中介軟體。

cues.en: Just a point to note.
Traffic has many middleware types like retry.
cues.zh: Traefik 有很多中介軟體類型，例如 retry，

cues.en: Then there is basic auth, then there's rate limit etc..
So within this retry we're going to tab like that.
cues.zh: 在 retry 裡繼續縮排，

cues.en: Then you're going to specify the number of attempts to retry the requests.
So you can say attempts and you can set that to three.
Then we're going to specify the initial interval between retries.
cues.zh: 再指定重試之間的初始間隔。

cues.en: So you can say initial interval.
We can set that to 500 milliseconds.
Then you can set up the providers so to the same line as Middlewares.
cues.zh: 接著在和 middlewares 同一層設定 providers。

cues.en: We're going to set up the providers.
And these are going to be used to specify the sources of the services and the routers.
cues.zh: 用來指定服務與路由器的來源。

cues.en: So you can say providers then tab.
We're going to specify the Docker provider.
And this is going to be used to get the services and the routers from the Docker daemon.
cues.zh: 它會從 Docker daemon 取得服務與路由器。

cues.en: As you can see Docker like that enter tab.
cues.zh: 輸入 docker，按 Enter，再縮排。

cues.en: Then we're going to specify an endpoint that is going to tell traffic how to connect to the Docker daemon.
cues.zh: 再指定 endpoint，告訴 Traefik 如何連接 Docker daemon。

cues.en: As you can see the endpoint.
And we're going to connect to the Docker daemon using a Unix socket, which is the standard way to connect to Docker daemon from Unix based systems.
cues.zh: 我們會透過 Unix socket 連接 Docker daemon，這是 Unix 系統連接 Docker daemon 的標準方式。

cues.en: As you can see in quotation marks Unix then three forward slashes.
cues.zh: 在引號裡輸入 unix，再接三個斜線。

cues.en: We're going to say var then slash run then slash docker dot sock like that.
Then we're going to tell traffic to watch for changes in Docker daemon and update the services and the routers accordingly.
cues.zh: 再告訴 Traefik，監看 Docker daemon 的變更，並相應更新服務與路由器。

cues.en: This is going to allow traffic to automatically detect changes in Docker containers and update the services and routers accordingly.
cues.zh: 這讓 Traefik 能自動偵測 Docker 容器變更，並更新服務與路由器。

cues.en: So you can see, watch and set that to true.
Then we're going to say expose by default.
And we're going to set that to false.
Let me explain.
These exposed by default tells traffic to expose all the services and the routers by default.
cues.zh: exposedByDefault 會告訴 Traefik，是否預設公開所有服務與路由器。

cues.en: In our case we're setting it to false because we want to explicitly specify which services and routers to expose then network.
cues.zh: 我們設為 false，因為要明確指定哪些服務與路由器可公開。接著是 network，

cues.en: We're going to specify the network that the Docker containers are running on.
cues.zh: 指定 Docker 容器執行所在的網路。

cues.en: And remember we had created this network before and it is next gen underscore local underscore network
cues.zh: 記得，之前建立的網路叫 nextgen_local_network，

cues.en: like that by setting the network to next gen, local network, traffic will only discover and expose the services and the routers that are running on this network.
cues.zh: 像這樣。設定為 nextgen_local_network 後，Traefik 只會探索並公開這個網路上執行的服務與路由器。

cues.en: And remember, we had created this network before.
cues.zh: 記得，這個網路之前已經建立。

cues.en: Then we can specify the entry points right there.
And the entry points define the network entry points that traffic is going to listen to for incoming requests.
cues.zh: entryPoints 定義 Traefik 接聽傳入請求的網路進入點。

cues.en: So the first entry point is going to be web.
This web is the custom name of the entry point.
cues.zh: web 是自訂的進入點名稱。

cues.en: Remember we could as well name this let's say web hyphen one or whichever name you want.
cues.zh: 記得，也可以叫 web-1，或任何你喜歡的名稱。

cues.en: So for this entry point we're going to specify the address that traffic is going to listen to for HTTP requests.
cues.zh: 對這個進入點，指定 Traefik 接聽 HTTP 請求的位址。

cues.en: In our case we can say so type it in.
You can say address.
And that's going to be double quotation marks or full colon 80.
So in our case we're specifying that the address that traffic is going to listen to for HTTP request is going to be port 80.
cues.zh: 也就是指定 Traefik 在 80 連接埠接聽 HTTP 請求。

cues.en: This full colon before 80 means listen on all available network interfaces.
cues.zh: 80 前面的冒號，代表接聽所有可用網路介面。

cues.en: Then you can save the file.
That's it for this lecture.
In the next lecture we're going to start working on our scripts.
cues.zh: 下一堂課開始編寫指令稿。
